Data.UnitTalk_VIE: nó sẽ kết thúc bằng <color=#F7BE45>cái chết</color>.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 머리가 멍해져, 반박도 의문도 가질 수 없었다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: My mind went blank. I could neither argue nor question what she had said.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 頭が真っ白になり、反論も疑問も浮かばなかった。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 脑中一片空白，无法反驳，也无法有任何疑问。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 腦中一片空白，無法反駁，也無法有任何疑問。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: La tête me tournait, je ne pouvais ni contredire ni remettre en question.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Mein Kopf war wie benommen, ich konnte weder widersprechen noch Fragen stellen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Mi cabeza está confusa, no puedo ni refutar ni cuestionar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Minha cabeça ficou confusa, não conseguia ter dúvidas nem objeções.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: หัวของฉันวุ่นวาย ฉันไม่สามารถโต้แย้งหรือตั้งคำถามได้
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Kepalaku terasa membengal, tidak bisa membantah atau mempertanyakan apa pun.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Đầu óc tôi bị choáng váng, tôi không thể phản đối hay đặt câu hỏi được.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 카넬리아가 여정에 참여한 이유.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: The reason Carnelia had joined the Journey.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: カネリアが旅に参加した理由。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 卡奈莉亚参与旅程的理由。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 卡奈莉亞參與旅程的理由。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: La raison de la participation de Canelia au voyage.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Der Grund für Kanelias Teilnahme an der Reise.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: La razón por la que Canelia participó en el viaje.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: A razão pela qual Canelia participou da jornada.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: เหตุผลที่คาเนลเรียมีส่วนร่วมในการเดินทางครั้งนี้
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Alasan Kanelia berpartisipasi dalam perjalanan ini.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Lý do Casneuria tham gia Hành trình.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 이야기의 서두에서 느껴졌던 불안의 이유.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: The reason I had felt uneasy when she started talking about herself.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 話の始まりに感じた不安の理由。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 故事开头感受到不安的理由。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 故事開頭感受到不安的理由。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: La raison de l'inquiétude ressentie au début de cette histoire.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Der Grund für die Angst, die ich am Anfang dieser Geschichte spürte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: La razón de la inquietud que sentí al principio de esta historia.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: A razão da ansiedade que senti no início da história.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: เหตุผลของความกังวลที่รู้สึกได้ตั้งแต่ต้นเรื่อง
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Alasan kekhawatiran yang dirasakan sejak awal cerita.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Lý do lo lắng mà tôi cảm thấy từ đầu câu chuyện.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 그리고... 내게 이야기하지 못했던 이유.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: And... the reason she had not been able to tell me.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: そして…私に話せなかった理由。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 以及…她无法告诉我的理由。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 以及…她無法告訴我的理由。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Et... la raison pour laquelle je n'ai pas pu en parler.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Und… der Grund, warum du mir das nicht erzählt hast.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Y... la razón por la que no me contaste.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: E... a razão pela qual não me contou.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: และ... เหตุผลที่ฉันไม่สามารถบอกเรื่องนี้ได้
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Dan... alasan mengapa kamu tidak menceritakannya kepadaku.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Và... lý do tôi không thể kể cho bạn nghe.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 그것은 모두, 그녀가 진정으로 바라는 한 가지 때문이었다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: All of it came down to the one thing she truly desired.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: それはすべて、彼女が本当に望む一つのもののためだった。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 那一切，都是因为她真正期望的唯一一件事。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 那一切，都是因為她真正期望的唯一一件事。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: C'était tout à cause d'une seule chose qu'elle désirait vraiment.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Das war alles wegen einer einzigen Sache, die sie sich wirklich wünschte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Todo ello se debía a una sola cosa que ella verdaderamente deseaba.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Tudo isso era porque havia uma coisa que ela realmente desejava.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ทั้งหมดนั้นเป็นเพราะมีเพียงสิ่งเดียวที่เธอหวังอย่างแท้จริง
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Semuanya karena ada satu hal yang benar-benar dia harapkan.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Tất cả đều vì một lý do duy nhất - cô ấy thực sự mong muốn.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 하지만... 막상 그것을 앞두고 나니 마음이 약해진 걸까요.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: But... perhaps now that the moment is near, my resolve has begun to waver.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: ですが…いざそれを目の前にすると、心が弱くなったのでしょうか。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 可是…一想那一刻真的即将到来，我也不由得动摇了起来。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 可是…一想那一刻真的即將到來，我也不由得動搖了起來。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Mais... maintenant que j'y suis confronté, mon cœur s'est-il affaibli?
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Aber… wenn ich daran denke, dass es unmittelbar bevorsteht, wird mir der Mut schwach.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Pero... cuando me vi frente a ello, mi corazón flaqueó.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Mas... agora que estou diante disso, meu coração ficou fraco.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แต่... เมื่อเห็นมันอยู่ตรงหน้า ใจฉันก็อ่อนแอลง
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Tapi... sekarang ketika menghadapinya, apakah hatiku menjadi lemah?
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Nhưng... khi đối mặt với nó, lòng tôi có trở nên yếu đuối không nhỉ?

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: ...분명, 그랬었는데.

Data.UnitTalk_CHN: …原本我的想法是不变的。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: …原本我的想法是不變的。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: ...C'est vrai, c'était comme ça.

Data.UnitTalk_PRT: ...Definitivamente, era assim.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ...แน่นอน มันเป็นแบบนั้น
Data.UnitTalk_IND: ...Jelas, itu memang begitu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: ...Chắc chắn, nó đã như vậy.

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Noch… ist es nicht entschieden, oder?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ยังคง... ไม่ได้ตัดสินใจใช่ไหม?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Vẫn còn... chưa được quyết định à?

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 솔직히 말씀드리면... 흔들리고 있습니다.

Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 老实说…我有点不知所措。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 老實說…我有點不知所措。

Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Nói thật thì... tôi đang dao động/lưỡng lự.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>모순</color>으로 끝날 저의 마지막이, 이토록 위태롭게요.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: My end, meant to conclude in <color=#F7BE45>contradiction</color>, has become so unstable.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>矛盾</color>で終わる私の最後が、こんなにも危うく。

Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 我那將以<color=#F7BE45>矛盾</color>告終的結局，竟然變得如此岌岌可危。

Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>Mâu thuẫn</color> sẽ kết thúc cuộc đời cuối cùng của tôi, lại còn nguy hiểm đến thế nữa.

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Then take a little more time to think it through.
